p75mock001.en: Point P is at an equal distance from the three vertices of a triangle with coordinates X (0, 0), Y (6, 0), and Z (0, 4). What are the coordinates of point P?
p75mock001.hi: बिंदु P त्रिभुज के तीनों शीर्षों से समान दूरी पर है, जिनके निर्देशांक X (0, 0), Y (6, 0), और Z (0, 4) हैं। बिंदु P के निर्देशांक क्या हैं?
options: (3, 2)
(2, 2)
(1.5, 2)
(2.5, 2.5)
p75mock001.sol:
P → Circumcentre (Intersection of perpendicular bisectors)

A = midpoint. of XY = (0+6)/2,(0+0)/2 = (3, 0)

Slope of XY = (0-0)/(0-6) = 0

Equation of ⊥ bisector of XY: x = 3

C = midpoint. of XZ = (0+0)/2,(0+4)/2 = (0, 2)

Slope of XZ = (4-0)/(0-0) = ∞

Equation of ⊥ bisector of XZ: y = 2

P = intersection of both lines

P = (3, 2)

p75mock001.en: A high-end watch is initially marked up by 40% above its cost price. During a sale, it is offered at a 20% discount on its marked price. However, a special customer receives a special discount of 25% on the discounted price, bringing the final selling price to ₹63,000. what was the original cost price and the difference between both the discount?
p75mock001.hi: एक हाई-एंड घड़ी की प्रारंभिक कीमत उसकी लागत मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित की गई थी। सेल के दौरान इसे उसके अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट के साथ पेश किया गया। हालांकि, एक विशेष ग्राहक को इस छूट के बाद मूल्य पर 25% की अतिरिक्त विशेष छूट मिली, जिससे अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य ₹63,000 हुआ। प्रारंभिक लागत मूल्य क्या थी और दोनों छूटों के बीच का अंतर कितना था?
options: ₹50,000 and 100
₹60,000 and 5000
₹75,000 and 0
₹80,000 and 50
p75mock001.sol:
Let original Cost Price = ₹x

Marked Price (MP) = 40% above CP

MP = 1.4x

First discount = 20% on MP

Price after first discount = 1.4x × 0.8

= 1.12x

Second discount = 25% on discounted price

Final Selling Price (SP) = 1.12x × 0.75

= 0.84x

Given, Final SP = ₹63,000

So,

0.84x = 63,000

x = 63,000 / 0.84

x = 75,000

Original Cost Price = ₹75,000

Now find both discounts in rupees

Marked Price = 1.4 × 75,000 = ₹1,05,000

First discount (20% of 1,05,000)

= 21,000

Price after first discount

= 1,05,000 − 21,000

= ₹84,000

Second discount (25% of 84,000)

= 21,000

Difference between both discounts

= 21,000 − 21,000 = ₹0

options: 5%
3%

p75mock001.sol:
Let total votes polled = 100x
Invalid votes = 1400
Valid = 100x – 1400
Loser candidate got = 42% = 42x
Winner = 100x – 1400 – 42x = 58x – 1400
Difference = 58x – 1400 – 42x = 3080
x = 280 so 100x= 28000
% of invalid votes = 100 = 5%

p75mock001.en: A rectangular parallelepiped has dimensions in arithmetic progression. If the sum of its dimensions is 24 cm and the volume is 384cm3 , find its dimensions.

3 cm, 7 cm, 11 cm
5 cm, 6 cm, 10 cm
2 cm, 7 cm, 12 cm
p75mock001.sol:
Using AP property,
Let the dimensions be a-d, a, a+d
ATQ, a-d + a + a+d=24
⇒3a=24
⇒a=8cm
ATQ, (a-d)×a×(a+d)=384cm³
(8-d)×8×(8+d)=384
64-d²=48
d²=16
d=4
Hence, dimensions are 4cm, 8cm, 12cm

p75mock003.en: The longest diagonal of a cuboid is equal to the diameter of a sphere in which it is inscribed. If the sphere’s radius is 20 cm, and two dimensions of the cuboid are 21 cm and 28 cm, what is the third dimension?

12√15 cm
5√15 cm
20 cm
p75mock003.sol:
When cuboid is inscribed in a sphere, its longest diagonal (space diagonal) is equal to diameter of the sphere
Therefore, cuboid diagonal =2×20cm=40cm
Using formula,
d²=l²+b²+h²
40²=21²+28²+h²
1600=441+784+h²
1600=1225+h²
h=√375=5√15
Third dimension =5√15 cm.

51000√3 cm3
54000√3 cm3

A=(3√3)/2 a²
given, a=12cm

A=216√3 cm²

Heights of sections are in AP
First term =6cm, Common difference =3cm Number of sections: 4
Heights: 6,9,12,15
=6+9+12+15=42cm
Volume of prism = Base Area × Total height
=216√3×42
=9072√3 cm³

p75mock004.en: Pipe A is capable of filling a tank in 16 minutes while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 24 minutes. Both pipes are opened together, but after 4 minutes, the rate of Pipe A doubles and the rate of Pipe B becomes half of its original. How many more minutes will it take to fill the tank completely?

After 4 minutes, Efficiency of A=3×2=6 (double)

Efficiency of B=2×1/2=1 (half)

Time taken to completely fill remaining =28 units

=28/(6+1)=4 minutes (more)

p75mock006.en: Train A running at 81 km/h takes 72 sec to overtake train B, when both the trains are running in the same direction, but it takes 36 sec to cross each other if the trains are running in the opposite direction. If the length of train B is 600 metres, then find the length of train A. [in metres]
p75mock006.hi: 81 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलने वाली ट्रेन A को ट्रेन B से आगे निकलने में 72 सेकंड लगते हैं, जब दोनों ट्रेनें एक ही दिशा में चल रही हों, लेकिन अगर ट्रेनें विपरीत दिशा में चल रही हों तो उन्हें एक-दूसरे को पार करने में 36 सेकंड लगते हैं। यदि ट्रेन B की लंबाई 600 मीटर है, तो ट्रेन A की लंबाई ज्ञात करें। [मीटर में]
options: 600
480
590
900
p75mock006.sol:
Let the length of train A is A
Let the speed of train B is x
Distance = relative speed × time
When both the trains are running in the same direction,
⇒ A + 600 = [81 – x] ×  × 72
⇒ A + 600 = [81 – x] × 20
⇒ A + 20 x = 1620 - 600
⇒ A + 20 x = 1020 --------- {1}
When both trains are running in the opposite direction:
Distance = relative speed × time
⇒ A + 600 = [81 + x] × × 36
⇒ A + 600 = [81 + x] × 10
⇒ A -  10 x = 810 - 600
⇒ A -  10 x = 210
Multiply both sides by 2
⇒ 2 A  -  20 x = 420
⇒ 20 x = 2 A - 420  --------- {2}
Now, put the value of eq. {2} in eq. {1}
⇒ A + 20 x = 1020
⇒ A + 2A - 420 = 1020
⇒ 3 A = 1440
⇒ A = 480

options: 14 cm
44 cm
54 cm
26 cm
p75mock007.sol:
In a trapezoid:

Sum of parallel sides = Sum of non-parallel sides

Since the sum of the opposite sides must be equal, the sum of the two parallel sides is also 22 cm.

Thus,

Perimeter = (Sum of non-parallel sides) + (Sum of parallel sides)

= 22 cm + 22 cm

= 44 cm

Let age of husband, wife and son = H, W, S

W = 90 – H – S -------- {i}
H – W = S
W = H – S -------- {ii}
From {i} & {ii} eqn ----
90 - H - S = H – S
270 = 6H + 2S -------- {iii}
→ From question – [H + 10] = 2[S+10]
H + 10 = 2S + 20
2S = H – 10 ------- {iv}
From eqn {iii} & {iv}
270 = 6H + H – 10
7H = 280
H = 40
2S = 270 – 6 × 40
S = 15 yr.
W = 40 – ×15 = 35 yrs

p75mock013.hi: बिंदु P, Q, R, S और T इसी क्रम में केंद्र O वाले वृत्त पर स्थित हैं। यदि जीवा TS व्यास PR के समान्तर है और RQT = 58° है तो RTS का माप [डिग्री में] ज्ञात कीजिए।
options: 58°
29°
45°
32°
p75mock013.sol:
PR // TS
Angle made by Semi-circle on circumference = 90 ̊
∴ ∠PQT = 90 ̊ - 58 ̊ = 32 ̊
∠PQT = ∠PRT {Angle made by same Arc}
∠PRT = ∠RTS {Alternate Interior Angle}
= 32 ̊

p75mock013.en: A right circular cylinder having the radius of r and height of h is inscribed in a sphere. The sphere’s diameter is d. What is the relationship between the height of the cylinder h and its radius r in terms of the sphere’s diameter d?
p75mock013.hi: एक गोले के अंदर एक लंब वृत्तीय बेलन बना हुआ है, जिसकी त्रिज्या r और ऊँचाई h है। गोले का व्यास d है। गोले के व्यास d के पदों में, बेलन की ऊँचाई h और उसकी त्रिज्या r के बीच क्या संबंध है?
options: h=√(d2-4r2)
2h=√(5d2-4r2)
3h=√(d2-r2)
h=√(5d2-4r2)
p75mock013.sol:
Let diameter of the circle be 'd'.
d²=h²+(2r)²
d²=h²+4r²
d²-4r²=h²
√(d²-4r²)=h

p75mock013.en: An iron triangle has a base 10 cm, height 12 cm. If the density is 7.8 g/cm3 and thickness is 2 cm, find the mass.
p75mock013.hi: एक लोहे के त्रिभुज का आधार 10 cm और ऊँचाई 12 cm है। यदि इसका घनत्व 7.8 g/cm³ और मोटाई 2 cm है, तो इसका द्रव्यमान ज्ञात कीजिए।
options: 936 g
748.8 g
706.4 g
620.6 g
p75mock013.sol:
Let the required mass be 'n'.
Density =Mass/Volume
ATQ; 7.8g/cm³=n/(Area × Thickness)
Area of triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height
= (1/2) × 10 × 12 = 60 cm²
Thickness = 2 cm (given)
Now,
7.8g/cm³=n/(60 × 2 cm³)
n = 936 gram

p75mock013.en: Seven years from now, Anamika will be as old as Malini was 4 years ago. Srinidhi was born 2 years ago. The average age of Anamika, Malini and Srinidhi 10 years from now will be 33 years. What is the present age of Anamika ?
p75mock013.hi: आज से सात साल बाद, अनामिका की उम्र उतनी ही होगी जितनी मालिनी की उम्र 4 साल पहले थी। श्रीनिधि का जन्म 2 साल पहले हुआ था। आज से 10 साल बाद अनामिका, मालिनी और श्रीनिधि की औसत उम्र 33 साल होगी। अनामिका की वर्तमान उम्र क्या है?
options: 30 years
29 years
31 years
28 years
p75mock013.sol:
A + 7= M - 4 -------------- {i}
Today Avg of A + M + S = 33 - 10 = 23
As Srinidhi was born 2 years ago, => S=2
A + M + 2 = [23] × 3
A + M = 69 - 2
= 67
M = 67- A ---------{ii}
From {i} & {ii}
A + 7= 67- A - 4
2A = 56
A = 28 yrs

p75mock013.en: If in PQR, P = 120°, PS QR at S and PQ + QS = SR, then the measure of Q is-
p75mock013.hi: यदि PQR में, P = 120°, PS QR, S पर तथा PQ + QS = SR, तो Q का माप क्या है?
options: 20°

p75mock013.sol:
Now; let T is a point on SR such that QS = ST = b [let] Now; △QPT,
QS = ST & PS ⊥ QT, then △QPT is an isosceles triangle
So, PQ = PT = a [let]
∵PQ + QS = SR
A + QS = ST + TR
a + b = b + TR ⇒TR = a
Now; ∵ PT = TR
Then ∠TPR = ∠TRP = θ [let]
∠TPR + ∠TRP = ∠PTQ [Exterior angle]
∠PTQ = θ + θ = 2θ = ∠PQT
In △PQR,
2θ + θ + 120 = 180
⇒ 3θ = 60 ̊
⇒ θ = 20 ̊, then ∠Q = 2θ = 40 ̊

i – ii
6B = 300

p75mock014.hi: एक व्यक्ति बैंक से 10% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर ₹1,00,000 उधार लेता है और पाँच वर्षों में ऋण चुका देता है। यदि ऋण चुकाने के लिए पहले, दूसरे, तीसरे और चौथे वर्ष के अंत में भुगतान की गई किश्तें क्रमशः ₹10,000, ₹20,000, ₹30,000 और ₹40,000 हैं, तो ऋण चुकाने के लिए पाँचवें वर्ष के अंत में कितनी राशि चुकानी चाहिए?
options: ₹38,250
₹30,000
₹40,450
₹367,45
p75mock014.sol:
1st year Interest =1,00,000×10%=10,000
Principal amount after 1styr =1,00,000-10,000=90,000
2ndyear Interest =90000×10%=9000
Similarly;
Principal after 2ndyr
90,000-20,000=70,000
3rdyear Interest =70000×10%=7000
Principal after 3rdyr=70,000-30,000=40,000
4th year interest=4000
∴ at the end of 5thyr, total interest
{1,00,000+90,000+70,000+40,000}×10%
⇒10,000+9000+7000+4000=30,000Ans

options: 14
19

5m × 20 = 10w × 15
m : w = 3 : 2
Total work = 5 × 3 × 20 = 300
=Work done in 5 days = [2m + 6w] × 5 = [6 + 12] ×5 = 90
= work left = 300 90 =210
Let remaining work will be done in ‘n’ days then

n =14 days

To fit perfectly inside a rectangle without overlapping the edges, the circle's diameter must be equal to the shorter side of the rectangle.

So, diameter = 16 cm

i.e., Radius (r) = 8 cm

= π × 82

p75mock018.en:
Consider the following two statements, labelled Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Evaluate them and choose the appropriate answer from the given options.

Assertion (A): Every composite number greater than one can be written as the result of multiplying prime numbers together.

Reason (R): The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic guarantees unique prime factorizations for all integers greater than 1
p75mock018.hi:
निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए, जिन्हें कथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। उनका मूल्यांकन कीजिए और दिए गए विकल्पों में से उचित उत्तर चुनिए।

कथन (A): 1 से बड़ी प्रत्येक संयुक्त संख्या को अभाज्य संख्याओं के गुणनफल के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है।

कारण (R): अंकगणित का मौलिक प्रमेय 1 से बड़ी सभी पूर्ण संख्याओं के लिए अद्वितीय अभाज्य गुणनखंडन की गारंटी देता है।
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
p75mock018.sol:
Assertion (A) is true as this statement describes the core concept of prime factorization. Every composite number, by definition, has factors other than 1 and itself, which can eventually be broken down into a product of prime numbers.

Reason (R) is true: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic states that every integer greater than 1 is either a prime number itself or can be represented as a product of prime numbers. Furthermore, this representation is unique, except for the order in which the prime factors are written.

p75mock019.en: Jehangir had to cover a distance of 90 km in an hour. During the first 25 minutes travelled at a speed of 15.2 metres per second. How many metres did Jehangir cover per second during the remaining period to reach his destination on time?
p75mock019.hi: जहाँगीर को एक घंटे में 90 किलोमीटर की दूरी तय करनी थी। पहले 25 मिनट के दौरान उसने 15.2 मीटर प्रति सेकंड की गति से यात्रा की। समय पर अपने गंतव्य तक पहुँचने के लिए जहाँगीर ने शेष अवधि के दौरान प्रति सेकंड कितने मीटर की दूरी तय की?
options: 30.8
32.5
32
31.2
p75mock019.sol:
Distance = 90km = 90000 m
Time =1h = 3600sec
Formula
Distance = speed × Time
Time spent = 25min = 25 × 60 = 1500sec
Distance covered in 25min
= 15.2 × 1500
= 22800m
Remaining Distance = 90000 - 22800
= 67200m
Remaining Time =3600 - 1500
= 2100sec
= 67200m/2100s = 32m/s

p75mock019.en: A circle is entirely enclosed within a parallelogram such that all four sides of the parallelogram are tangent to the circle. What particular type of parallelogram must this be?
p75mock019.hi: एक वृत्त पूरी तरह से एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के भीतर इस प्रकार घिरा हुआ है कि समांतर चतुर्भुज की चारों भुजाएँ वृत्त को स्पर्श करती हैं। यह समांतर चतुर्भुज किस विशेष प्रकार का होना चाहिए?
options:
Rectangle

Trapezoid

Square

Rhombus
p75mock019.sol:
A circle can be inscribed within a parallelogram (meaning it is tangent to all four sides) only if the parallelogram is a tangential quadrilateral.

In tangential quadrilateral, sum of opposite sides are equal.

AB+CD= BC +DA

CAB=CD and BC=DA

opposite side of parallelogram are equal

2 (AB)=2(BC)

⇒ AB = BC

Thus, a parallelogram with adjacent sides equal is a Rhombus.

p75mock020.en: In an election, 2% persons enrolled in the voter list did not participate and 500 votes were invalid. Two candidates A and B fought the election, and A defeated B by 200 votes. If 43% of the persons enrolled in the voter list casted their votes in favour of A, then what is the number of the total casted votes?

options: 2450
2800
3000
3250
p75mock020.sol:
Total votes = 100x
2% did not participate = 2x
Remaining = 98x
Invalid = 98x – 500
A got = 43x
B got = {98x – 500} – 43x = 55x – 500
Difference =43x-{55x-500} =200
-12x+500=200
300=12x
x=25
Total no. of casted votes = 98x
=>98×25=2450

p75mock020.en: A regular right pyramid with an equilateral triangular base of side 20 cm is completely submerged in a cylindrical tank of radius 12 cm, initially filled with water to a height of 30 cm. The pyramid’s apex just touches the bottom of the tank. Given that the water level in the tank rises to 34 cm after the pyramid is submerged, find the perpendicular height of the pyramid.
p75mock020.hi: एक समबाहु त्रिभुजाकार आधार वाला (जिसकी भुजा 20 cm है) एक नियमित लंब पिरामिड, 12 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक बेलनाकार टैंक में पूरी तरह से डुबो दिया जाता है। यह टैंक शुरू में 30 cm की ऊँचाई तक पानी से भरा हुआ था। पिरामिड का शीर्ष टैंक के तल को ठीक छूता है। यह देखते हुए कि पिरामिड को डुबोने के बाद टैंक में पानी का स्तर बढ़कर 34 cm हो जाता है, पिरामिड की लंबवत ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
options: 23 cm
27.12 cm
20.14 cm
31.3 cm
p75mock020.sol:
When the pyramid is submerged the rise in water level equals the volume displaced.
water rise =34-30=4cm=ΔH
volume displaced =πr²×ΔH (in cylindrical tank)
=π(12)²×4
=576πcm³

this equals volume of pyramid.
Volume of Pyramid =1/3× Base Area × height
1/3×√3/4×20×20×h
ATQ,
1/3×100√3×h=576π
1/3×100×√3×h=576×22/7
h=(576×22×3)/(100×√3×7)
h=31.3cm

p75mock020.en: Three concentric circles are designed as part of a target practice board. Their diameters form an arithmetic progression. If the smallest circle has a circumference of 8π cm and the largest circle has the circumference of 20π cm, what is the circumference of the middle circle?
p75mock020.hi: एक टारगेट प्रैक्टिस बोर्ड के हिस्से के तौर पर तीन संकेंद्रित वृत्त बनाए गए हैं। उनके व्यास एक समांतर श्रेणी बनाते हैं। यदि सबसे छोटे वृत्त की परिधि 8π cm है ​​और सबसे बड़े वृत्त की परिधि 20π cm है, तो बीच वाले वृत्त की परिधि क्या होगी?
options: 14π cm
10π cm
12π cm
11π cm
p75mock020.sol:
using circumference of circle = 2πr (where r is radius)

ATQ,

Circumference of smaller circle = 8π

Now, let radius of smaller circle = r

2πr=8π

r=4

Similarly, according to question

2πr’ =20π (r’ radius of largest)

r’=10

let radius of middle circle = R and given they are in AP hence, take r = a , R = a+d , r’= a+2d

r’ – r = 10-4=6

a + 2d – a = 6

2d = 6

d = 3

So, R = 4+3 = 7 cm

Circumference of middle circle = 2πr=2π×7=14π

= (8-5)²=3²=9

₹5400
₹72000
₹14400

Disc = 10%; SP = 9/10 × 112/100 × CP

→ x = ₹14,400

21%

Between 20 to 25 years = 28x
Who actually voted 28x×75%= 21x
×100=21%

p75mock021.hi: एक व्यक्ति ने ₹25,000 की राशि का एक-चौथाई हिस्सा साधारण ब्याज की एक निश्चित दर पर तथा शेष राशि को 4% प्रति वर्ष की उच्च दर पर निवेश किया। यदि 2 वर्षों के लिए प्राप्त कुल ब्याज ₹4125 है। दूसरी राशि किस दर पर निवेश की गई?
options:
9.5%

    9.25%

    5.25%    

    7.5%
p75mock021.sol:
A.T.Q;
\( \frac{25000 \times r \times 2}{100 \times 4} + \frac{25000 \times (r + 4) \times 2 \times 3}{100 \times 4} = 4125 \)
500r+1500r+6000=16500
r=5.25%
second sum was invested at 9.25.

p75mock021.en: The bathroom floor measurers 4 m in length and 1.2 m in width. One of its walls which is also to be tiled fully, measures 2.5 m in length and 3 m in height. p75mock021.hi: बाथरूम के फ़र्श की लंबाई 4 m और चौड़ाई 1.2 m है। इसकी एक दीवार, जिस पर पूरी तरह से टाइलें लगानी हैं, की लंबाई 2.5 m और ऊँचाई 3 m है। यदि 30 cm भुजा वाली वर्गाकार टाइलें इस्तेमाल की जाती हैं, और कटाई व बर्बादी को ध्यान में रखते हुए 10% अतिरिक्त टाइलें खरीदी जाती हैं, तो कुल कितनी टाइलों की आवश्यकता होगी?
options: 90
151
115
85
p75mock021.sol:
Area of bathroom floor =4m×1.2m
=4.8m²
Area of wall =2.5m×3m
=7.5m²

Total area to be tiled =4.8+7.5m²
=12.3m²
Area of one tile = (side)²= (0.3m)²
=0.09m²

Tiles required without wastage=12.3/0.09
=137 (approx.)

Now, an extra of 10%
is needed =10% of 137
=13.7
Total tiles needed =137+13.7
=151 tiles (approx)

options: 1860 cm2
2000 cm2
1720 cm2
1890 cm2
p75mock029.sol:
Let the sides be ' a ' and ' b ' and height ' h ' = 20 cm (given)
Base area =300cm² , diagonal (d) =25cm
ab=300cm²
d²=a²+b²
25²=a²+b²
625=a²+b²
(a+b)²=a²+b²+2ab=625+2×300
=1225
(a+b)=35

Total surface Area of rectangular parallelepiped
=2(ab+ah+bh)
=2[ab+h(a+b)]
=2[300+20(35)]cm²
=2[300+700]cm²
=2000cm²

⇒ [3 + 2 - 1] × 1 + 5 × t = 36

options: 4950 m2
5670 m2
7860 m2
2450 m2
p75mock032.sol:
Inner radius (r) = 45 m (given)
A second embankment is built around it with a width of 15 m.
Outer radius (R) = 45 m + 15 m = 60 m
Area of region between two embankments:
= π (60² - 45²) m²
= (22/7) × 105 × 15
(using a² – b² = (a+b)*(a-b))
= 4950 m²

69 kg

options: 12.63 cm
11.63 cm
13.63 cm
14.63 cm
p75mock032.sol:
Using Formula:

Surface Area of sphere =4πr²
ATQ, 4π[(r+3)²-r²]=990
4×22/7 (r²+9+6r-r² )=990
6r+9=(45×7)/4
6r+9=78.75
6r=69.75
r=11.63cm

options: 800 cm3
950 cm3
1584 cm3
1200 cm3

Base Area = (side)²
=6²=36cm²

First height =5cm Fourth height =17cm
n=4
Sum of heights =4/2(5+17)cm
=44cm

Volume = Base Area × Total height
=44cm×36cm²
=1584cm³.

options: -5
3

-4
p75mock035.sol:

squaring both side

p75mock035.en: The speed of two railway engines is in the ratio 5 : 4. If the move on parallel tracks in the same direction and if the slower engine is ahead of the faster engine by 8 km when the latter starts, then how far will the faster engine have to travel before it overtakes the slower one?

options: 48km
32km
40km
36km
p75mock035.sol:
Let the speed of the faster engine is 5 km/hr
And the speed of the slower engines is 4 km/hr
The distance between two engines = 8 km
Time taken to overtake slower engine = = 8 hr
Distance covered by the faster engine in 8 hrs = 5 × 8 = 40 km

p75mock035.en: The area of rectangle is 36 cm2 more than that of a square. If the length of the rectangle is 3 cm more than the side of the square and the breadth of the rectangle is 1 cm less than the side of the square, then find the perimeter of both the square and the rectangle.
p75mock035.hi: एक आयत का क्षेत्रफल एक वर्ग के क्षेत्रफल से 36 cm² अधिक है। यदि आयत की लंबाई वर्ग की भुजा से 3 cm अधिक है और आयत की चौड़ाई वर्ग की भुजा से 1 cm कम है, तो वर्ग और आयत, दोनों का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
options: 108 cm , 122 cm
78 cm , 82 cm
145 cm , 156 cm
125 cm , 140 cm
p75mock035.sol:
Let the side of square be x

Length of rectangle = x + 3

Breadth of rectangle = x − 1

ATQ,

(x + 3)(x − 1) − x² = 36

x² + 2x − 3 − x² = 36

2x = 39

x = 19.5 cm

So,

Perimeter of square = 4 × 19.5 cm = 78 cm

And,

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

= 2(2x + 2)

= 2(2 × 19.5 + 2)

= 2(41) = 82 cm

p75mock035.en: The side ST and TR and the median SU of the STR are equal to the sides MN, NJ and the median MV of the MNJ Respectively. If TSU = 46°, NMJ = 79°, MVN = 88°, what is the degree measure of 7/11 \(\angle\)SRT?
p75mock035.hi: STR की भुजा ST और TR तथा माध्यिका SU क्रमशः MNJ की भुजाओं MN, NJ तथा माध्यिका MV के बराबर हैं। यदि TSU = 46°, NMJ = 79°, MVN = 88° है, तो 7/11 \(\angle\)SRT का डिग्री माप क्या है?
options:
35°

    55°

    47°    

    56°
p75mock035.sol:
∆STU ≅ ∆MNJ, therefore, SUT= MVN = 88°
And STU = MNV = 180° - [88° + 46°] = 46°

Therefore, SRT= MJN = 180° [79° + 46°] = 55°

7/11\(\angle\) =7/1155° = 35°

p75mock035.en: An alloy contains 40% of silver, 30% of copper and 30% of nickel. How much silver [in kg] should be added to 25 kg of the alloy so that the new alloy contains 50% of silver?
p75mock035.hi: एक मिश्र धातु में 40% चांदी, 30% तांबा और 30% निकल है। 25 किलोग्राम मिश्र धातु में कितनी चांदी [किलोग्राम में] मिलाई जानी चाहिए ताकि नए मिश्र धातु में 50% चांदी हो?
options: 5
10
12
20
p75mock035.sol:
Weight of silver in 25 kg = 25 ×40%=10 kg
Let the amount of silver added = a kg
Then as per question,
[10+a] = [25+a]
=20+2a=25+a
= a= 5 kg
Hence 5 kg silver is required to add in 25 kg alloy so that new alloy contains 50% of silver.

p75mock036.en: A can do a piece of work in 30 days, B in 50 days and C in 40 days. If A is assisted by B on one day and by C on the next day alternately, the work will be completed in:

p75mock036.sol:
Order to complete the work in alternate days =
A+B, A+C
32 + 35 = 67
2 days  =  67 work
× 8             × 8
16 days = 536
17th day = 32

Work completed in 17 days = 536+32 = 568

On the 18th day A+C will do the remaining work

options: 558 km
650 km
560 km
552 km
p75mock036.sol:
Distance travelled in the first one hour was 35 km,
Distance travelled in 2nd hour = 35 + 2 = 37 km
Distance travelled by car in every hour will be in Arithmetic Progression.
35, 37, 39… up to 12 terms
First term = a = 35,
Common difference = d = 37 – 35 = 2,
Number of terms = n = 12
Formula∶ = {2a + [n – 1]d}
Total distance travelled in 12 hours = {2 × 35 + [12 – 1]2}
= 6[70 + 22] = 6 × 92 = 552 km

options: 54
56
58
62

Avg. = 40:A
(8×40 + 4×A)/12 = 45
320 + 4A = 540
A = 55

Sum of all four workers = 55×4 = 220
W₁ + W₂ + W₃ + W₄ = 220
50 + 46 + x + x = 220
2x = 124
x = 62

p75mock039.en: Train 'A' requires 15 seconds to cross train 'B' of length 300 m moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 36 km/h. Further, train 'A' requires 30 seconds to cross a 500 m long stationary train 'C'. Find the length [in m] of train 'A'.

options: 200
300
250
275
p75mock039.sol:
Speed of train B = 36 km/hr = 36 × =10 m/sec
Let the length of train A be a and its speed be s m/sec
Distance = speed × time
300 + a = [s + 10]15……………eq1
'A' requires 30 seconds to cross a 500 m long stationary train 'C'.
500 + a = s × 30…………………eq2
From eq 1 and eq 2
A = 15s + 150 - 300
A = 30s - 500
Equating both the above equations
15s + 150 - 300 = 30s - 500
350 = 15s
s = m/sec
Put the value of s in eq 2 to find the value of a
500 + a = s × 30
500 + a =700
a = 200 m

options: ₹12,000
₹10,000
₹11,600
₹11,400
p75mock039.sol:
Required Area to be polished = CSA of outer hemisphere + CSA Inner hemisphere + upper area of the ring part

= 2πR² + 2πr² + πR² - πr²

= 2π[R² + r²] + π(R² - r²)
= 2π[64 + 36] + π(64 - 36)
= 2π × 100 + π × 28 = 228π cm²


Cost of π cm² = ₹50
∴ Cost of 228π cm² = ₹50 × 228 = ₹11,400

A large solid cube is melted and cast into 'N' small solid spheres, each of radius 3 cm, and 'N + 2' small solid cuboids, each of dimensions 4 cm × 4 cm × 6.5 cm. If the length of each side of the large solid cube is 12 cm, then find the value 'N'.
[Use = 22/7] ?
p75mock040.hi:
एक बड़े ठोस घन को पिघलाकर 'N' छोटे ठोस गोले बनाए गए हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक की त्रिज्या 3 सेमी है, और 'N + 2' छोटे ठोस घनाभ बनाए गए हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक का आयाम 4 सेमी × 4 सेमी × 6.5 सेमी है। यदि बड़े ठोस घन की प्रत्येक भुजा की लंबाई 12 सेमी है, तो 'N' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
[= 22/7 का प्रयोग करें] ?
options: 6
7
5
8
p75mock040.sol:
Volume of cube = a³
Volume of large cube = 12³
=1728 cm³            
Volume of sphere = πr³
= π ×3³
= 36πcm³
Volume of cuboid = l × b × h
= 4 × 4 × 6.5 = 104cm³
Volume of [N + 2]cuboid = [N + 2] ×104
Total volume after melting:
V of cube = V of sphere + V of cuboids
1728 = N × 36π + 104[N + 2]
N = 7

p75mock040.en: Meena took a loan of ₹10,000 at 10% compound interest per annum for 3 years. She repaid ₹5,000 at the end of the 1st year and the rest at the end of the 3rd year. Find the total interest paid by Meena.
p75mock040.hi: मीना ने 3 साल के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर ₹10,000 का ऋण लिया। उसने पहले साल के अंत में ₹5,000 और बाकी राशि तीसरे साल के अंत में चुका दी। मीना द्वारा चुकाया गया कुल ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
options: ₹1,850
₹2,260
₹2,050
₹1,920
p75mock040.sol:
For first year → (10,000×10)/100=1000₹ (Interest)
Amount at end of 1st year =11000
repaid =5000
Amount left =(11000-5000)=6000

At end of 3rd year, 6000×11/10×11/10=7260
Interest generated =(7260-6000)=1260
Total interest =1260+1000=2260

₹60,000

₹65,000
p75mock040.sol:

B = ₹2,00,000

⇒ Profit Ratio =1:1

⇒ A's share = ₹60,000

p75mock040.en: A train takes 7 seconds to pass man standing on a platform and another train whose length is double that of the first train, and moving in the opposite direction, takes 10 seconds to pass him. The time taken [in seconds, to the nearest integer] by the trains to pass each other will be:

9
8

p75mock040.sol:
Let D be the length of the first train [in meters],
v be the speed of the first train [in m/s],
u be the speed of the second train [in m/s].
The first train takes 7 seconds to pass a man, so its speed is v = m/s.
The second train has length 2D and takes 10 seconds to pass a man, so its speed is u = = D/5 m/s.
Since the trains are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed is v + u = + = m/s.
The total length the trains need to cover to pass each other is 3D.
The time taken will be =

t = = = 8.75 seconds.
~9 seconds

p75mock040.en: A ladder is leaning against a wall makes an angle ‘x’ with the horizontal ground such that tanx=105/140. If the length of the ladder is 26 metres, then what is the distance (in metres) of the foot of the ladder from the wall?
p75mock040.hi: एक सीढ़ी दीवार के सहारे टिकी हुई है और ज़मीन के साथ ‘x’ कोण बनाती है, इस तरह कि tanx = 105/140 है। यदि सीढ़ी की लंबाई 26 मीटर है, तो सीढ़ी के निचले सिरे से दीवार की दूरी (मीटर में) कितनी होगी?
options: 50 metres
35.4 metres
20.8 metres
41.6 metres
p75mock040.sol:
tan x = 105/140 = Perpendicular / Base
= 3/4
(3,4,5) is a triplet
Hypotenuse = 5
give 5 unit → 26 metres
1 unit → 5.2 metres
Distance of foot of ladder from wall = 4 unit
= 5.2 × 4 metres
= 20.8 metres

p75mock041.hi: A और B समान रूप से कुशल हैं, और यदि कोई भी छुट्टी नहीं लेता है, तो प्रत्येक व्यक्ति 30 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है। A और B ने इस काम पर एक साथ काम करना शुरू किया, लेकिन A ने हर चार दिन के काम के बाद एक दिन की छुट्टी ले ली, जबकि B ने हर पाँच दिन के काम के बाद एक दिन की छुट्टी ले ली। यदि उन्होंने एक साथ 01 अगस्त 2022 को काम शुरू किया था, तो किस तारीख को काम पूरा हुआ?
options: 19 August 2022
17 August 2022
16 August 2022
18 August 2022
p75mock041.sol:
Let A's efficiency is = B’s efficiency is =1
Total work = 30 × 1= 30 unit
On1st 4 days total work completed⇒ 8 units
5th & 6th day work completed = 2 units
6 days × 3 →10 units × 3
18 days → 30 units complete
So work will complete on 18th Aug 2022

p75mock041.en: A cube is having surface area of 3600 square units. Its volume would increase approximately____ if the side is increased by 4 units.

options: 45 %
57%
55%
50%
p75mock041.sol:
Surface area of cube =6a²
ATQ; 6a²=3600
a²=600
a=√600=10√6=24.49≃24.5

If side increased by 4 cm
New side =24.49+4=28.49≃28.5
Ratio of side =24.5:28.5
=49:57

Volume's Ratio =(49)³:(57)³
117649:185193
Percentage change in volume =(185193-117649)/117649×100
=67544/117649×100
=57% (Approximately)

p75mock041.en: The average age of 18 players in a hockey team is the same as it was 3 years ago because 6 players, whose current average age is 30 years, were replaced by 6 new players. What is the average age of the newcomers?

options: 15 years
18 years
21 years
24 years

Let average age of 18 players be A.

Average 3 years ago = A – 3

Let sum of ages of newcomers be B.

ATQ,

(18A-6×30+B)/18=(A-3)

B = 180-54=126

Average of B = 126/6=21

₹2, ₹5, ₹10

p75mock042.en: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at a constant speed of 12 km/h. A policeman reaches the spot 10 minutes later and immediately starts chasing the thief. After 30 minutes of chasing, the distance between the thief and the policeman is still 600 meters. At what distance from the spot of the crime will the policeman catch the thief, and what is the speed (in km/h) at which the policeman runs?
p75mock042.hi: एक चोर कोई चीज़ चुराता है और 12 km/h की स्थिर गति से दौड़ते हुए भाग निकलता है। एक पुलिसवाला 10 मिनट बाद घटनास्थल पर पहुँचता है और तुरंत चोर का पीछा करना शुरू कर देता है। 30 मिनट तक पीछा करने के बाद भी, चोर और पुलिसवाले के बीच की दूरी अभी भी 600 मीटर है। अपराध स्थल से कितनी दूरी पर पुलिसवाला चोर को पकड़ लेगा, और पुलिसवाला किस गति (km/h में) से दौड़ता है?
options:
9.6 km, 15 km/h

10 km, 16 km/h

10.57 km, 14.8 km/h

11 km, 17 km/h
p75mock042.sol:
Let speed of police be S.
In 10 min → Thief's dist. = 12 × 1/6 = 2 km
After 30 min → Thief's dist. = 0.6 km
Rel dist = Rel speed × t ⇒ (2 - 0.6) = (S - 12) × 1/2 ⇒ S = 14.8 km/h
Time to catch = 2 / (14.8 - 12) = 2 / 2.8 h
Dist. from crime spot = 20/28 × 148/10 = 10.57 km

22

options: 50
45
65
75
p75mock043.sol:
Time ratio:
A : B = 4 : 5 & [A+B] : [A+B-C] = 5 : 9
Eff. Ratio:
A : B = 5 : 4 & [A+B] : [A+B-C] = 9 : 5
With above equation, eff. Of A = 5, B = 4 and C = -4
TW = 40×5 = 200
Time taken by C to empty = 200/4 = 50 hrs.

The speed of the current = m/s =  × = 0.6 km/hr

2100 km
345 km
400 km
p75mock047.sol:
Let the time of travelling be’t’ hours
Distance travelled by train with speed 80 km/h in t hours = 80t
Distance travelled by train with speed 95 km/h in t hours = 95t 
Difference in distance travelled by two train = 95 t - 80t = 180 
⇒ 15t = 180 
⇒ t = 12 hours 
Distance between stations = 80 ×12 + 95 × 12 = 960 + 1140 = 2100km

time taken by Anil to reach B = = 3hr

options: B would have won by 8%
B would have won by 3%
A would have won by 3%
A would have won by 8%
p75mock050.sol:
Let total votes polled = 100
Invalid votes = 100 = 20%
Also, A-B = 2500 which is equal to 10% of total votes {given}
So, total votes polled = ×100=25000

i.e B will get 2000 more votes than that of A get
So, B wins by 100 = 8%

CSA of cylinder =2πrh
=2×22/7×14

2:1

3:4

p75mock051.sol:
Let the price of standard flour per kg be ₹1.

So, price of premium flour = ₹ 2.

Let x kg of standard flour be used.

Cost = Price × Quantity

Total cost = 12×2 + x×1 = 24+x

Total cost after interchanging = x×2+12×1 = 2x+12

A⋅T⋅Q,

2x+12 = {80(24+x)}/100

∴ x = 6

The sum of the digits of 2941 = 16

p75mock054.en: If the interior angle of a regular polygon is k times its exterior angle, express the number of sides (n) of the polygon in terms of k.

options:
2k + 4

2k - 8

2k + 2

4k – 5
p75mock054.sol:
Let the exterior angle = x

Interior angle = Kx

Interior + Exterior = 180°

x(K+1)=180°

Exterior angle =x=180/(K+1)

Also Exterior angle = (360°)/x(n: number of side)

(180°)/(K+1)=(360°)/x=n=2(K+1)

= 2K + 2

= (2)2

= 4 sq unit.

p75mock057.sol:
Numbers which are perfect square and perfect cube are 1,64,729 etc.
1 is to less to fulfill the condition of question.
Thus taking 64,
[1+3+5+7+⋯]= 64
⇒ sum of first n odd numbers =n2
∴ sum of first 8 odd numbers =82=64 thus n=8
∴ total 8 days from 1st Jan2023 i.e.
08Jan2023.

p75mock057.en: If x²-1, 2x and x²+1 are the three sides of a right angled triangle, then find which of the following can be its hypotenuse?
p75mock057.hi: यदि x²-1, 2x और x²+1 एक समकोण त्रिभुज की तीन भुजाएँ हैं, तो ज्ञात कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा इसकी कर्ण हो सकता है?
options:
x2 - 1

x2 + 1

x2

2 x
p75mock057.sol:
x²+1,x²-1,2x
x²+1>x²-1 for all value of x
Now, take x²+1 as hypotenuse
(x²+1)²=(x²-1)²+(2x)²
x⁴+1+2x²=x⁴+1-2x²+4x²
x⁴+1+2x²=x⁴+1+2x²
L.H.S = R.H.S
Thus, from above we can conclude 'x²+1" can be the hypotenuse.
→ When we take 2x as hypotenuse, LHS≠ RHS.

p75mock060.en: The distance between the centers of two circles is d. The lengths of their direct and transverse common tangents are L and M, respectively. If L²+M²=200 and the sum of the squares of their radii is 100, what is the value of d?
p75mock060.hi: दो वृत्तों के केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी d है। उनकी सीधी और अनुप्रस्थ उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाई क्रमशः L और M है। यदि L²+M²=200 और उनकी त्रिज्याओं के वर्गों का योग 100 है, तो d का मान क्या है?
options: 20
10√2
5√2
10
p75mock060.sol:
Formula Used

Direct common tangent (L):
L² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² ---(i)

Transverse common tangent (M):
M² = d² - (r₁ + r₂)² ---(ii)

Adding equations (i) and (ii):
L² + M² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² + d² - (r₁ + r₂)²
= 2d² - [r₁² - 2r₁r₂ + r₂² + r₁² + 2r₁r₂ + r₂²]
= 2d² - 2(r₁² + r₂²)

Given: L² + M² = 200, r₁² + r₂² = 100
200 = 2d² - 2×100
d² = 200
d = √200 = 10√2

p75mock061.sol:
Effective rate of 2years, 3 years and 4 years at the rate of 10% is 21%, 33.1% and 46.41%

using Pythagoras theorem in ∆OAT.

=44% (Approx)

p75mock062.en: A water tank is shaped like a composite prism: the bottom part is a triangular prism with base area 100cm^2and height 1.4 m , while the top part is a rectangular prism with base 60 cm x 25 cm and height 0.9 m. what is the total volume of the tank in litres? (1m3=1000L)

options: 103.2L
134.4L
149L
272.8L
p75mock062.sol:
Volume of triangular prism = Base Area × Height
=100×140 (∵1.4m=140cm)
=14000cm³

Volume of rectangular prism = Base Area × Height
=60×25×90cm³
=135000cm³

Total volume =14000+135000cm³
=149000cm³
1L=1000cm³
⇒149000/1000=149 litres

C² = AB
A + B = C
p75mock062.sol:
Using formula, SI = (P×R×T)/100
B = (A×R×T)/100 (i)
C = (B×R×T)/100 (ii)
Dividing equation (i) by (ii) we get

options: 8.64 cm
86.4 cm
864 cm
8640 cm
p75mock063.sol:
Nothing to do with given radius.
We are to find the length of the rope, which is simply the distance the bucket travels vertically upward in 72 seconds.
Distance = Speed × time
= 1.2 m/s × 72s = 86.4m or 864 cm

Inradius [r] = 3 cm
Circumradius [R] = 12.5 cm
Now,
R =

H = 2R = 2 × 12.5 = 25 cm

P + B = 31

= 24000

p75mock073.en: In a ABC, points P, Q and R are taken on AB, BC and CA, respectively, such that BQ = PQ and QC = QR. If BAC = 75°. What is the measure of PQR [in degrees]?

Given the, ∠A = 75 ̊
BQ = PQ & QC = QR
Let ∠PQR = x ̊

Then in ∠ABC
75 + b + c = 180 ̊
b + c = 105 ̊
Now; in ∠BPQ,
b + b + ∠BQP = 180 ̊
∠BQP = 180 ̊ - 2b

Similarly, ∠CQR =180 - 2C

adding both;
∠BQP + ∠CQR = 360 ̊ - 2[b + c] = 360 ̊ - 2[105 ̊] = 150 ̊

Now,

∴150 ̊ + x =180 ̊ => x = 30 ̊

∴∠PQR + 2 × 75 ̊= 180 ̊
∠PQR = 30 ̊

options: 1080

1000
800
p75mock074.sol:
Each exterior angle =(360°)/n (n ; number of side)

= (360°)/8=45°

Each interior angle = 180°-45° = 135°

(∵ Exterior + interior angle = 180°, in a polygon)

Sum of all interior angle = 135°×8=1080°

given = Sum of 7 interior angle = 1000°

8th interior angle = (1080°-1000°)

= 80°

⇒So, 8th exterior angle = 180°-80°=100°
